textRange.selectedText: Hardware-level telemetry and cryptographically verifiable audit trails are not cheap

comments.body: Hardware based telemetry has to be done at the chip/system level which means it because an industry standard.   There are free Open Source projects (e.g. VeritasChain) to provide cryptographically verifiable audit trails.

comments.author: jsnover

textRange.selectedText: A measles injury is tabulable; the VICP runs on a fixed injury table precisely because the harm set is bounded and known. A credit-scoring model or a diagnostic model writes new failure modes with every retrain.

comments.body: Can we come up with a per-domain harm table for AI usage?  If we can't, then exactly how does an AI vendor know what to protect against?

textRange.selectedText: A person denied a loan or screened out of a job often does not know an automated decision touched them, so a board that pays filed claims and a tax priced at admission both fail as deterrents for the harms no one files

comments.body: Isn't this also the case with class action suits? We just need someone to identify the issue.
